import serial
import time
import csv

#PRESSURE ONLY

offset = 30000; #counts | was 111000
scale = 160000; #counts per pound
serial_port = serial.Serial("com7", 57600)

#for calibration and conversion
def raw_to_lbf(data):
    return float(data) 
    #return float((float(data) - offset) / scale)

def serial_reader(runTime):
    with open('data.csv', 'w', newline='') as data_: #NEW LINE IS NOLONGER MADE newline='' sets null to new line
        datawriter = csv.writer(data_)
        startTime = time.time() #set inital time
        datawriter.writerow(["Time", "Load (lbf)"]) #column headers
        looptime = 0
        while looptime <= runTime : #run until ctrl c
            input = serial_port.readline().decode("utf-8").strip() #takes in one line of XBEE data
            #arduino sends "Raw " (4 characters) before the actual raw data
            data = input[4:]

            #raw data needs to be calibrated and converted to lbf
            pressure = round(raw_to_lbf(data), 4) #sets 4 decimal places

            datawriter.writerow([looptime, pressure]) #WRITES EACH VALUE
            looptime = time.time() - startTime

        print("Done collecting.")

print("Enter number of seconds to run data collection: ")
serial_reader(int(input()))
